title: Written Order and Authorization Validity Terms (Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program)
content:
The Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program measures the life of its paperwork in the following tier figures.

| Tier | Written order valid, calendar months from the order date | Prior authorization required | Prior authorization valid, calendar months from the payer decision date | Earliest renewal, calendar days before the valid-through date | Standard decision time, calendar days | Expedited decision time, hours | Coverage re-verified within, calendar months before the ship date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Testing Supplies Self-Pay Program | 12 | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Testing Supplies Commercial HMO Program | 12 | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 6 |
| Testing Supplies Commercial PPO Program | 12 | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 12 |
| Testing Supplies Medicare Advantage Program | 12 | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 12 |
| Testing Supplies Original Medicare Program | 12 | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 12 |
| Testing Supplies Medicaid Program | 6 | Yes | 12 | 21 | 7 | 72 | 1 |

**Notes to the table**

1. *Prior authorization required* states whether the payer requires prior authorization before this product line ships.
2. A prior authorization is valid for its figure in calendar months from the payer's decision date, unless the payer's approval states an earlier valid-through date. A 0 in the validity, renewal or decision columns means there is no prior authorization on the tier.
3. The standard decision time counts calendar days from the request date; the expedited decision time counts hours from submission.
4. The re-verification column states how recently the coverage record must have been verified with the payer before a refill ships; 0 means there is no coverage to verify, which is the case on the self-pay tier.

Only the Testing Supplies Medicaid Program combines a shorter order life of 6 months with a prior authorization of 12 months; on every other tier the written order, valid for 12 months, is the only document whose life is counted.
